Description

The Manor is a new shop located near the Taiga and the bridge to the Desert. The shop is a part of the 2024 and 2025 Halloween Event and uses both Cash and Candy, similar to the Ghoulish Goods shop.

At the top of The Manor is an Altar that you can use to craft the Crater Chisel, Astral Saw, Starlight Sickle, Celestial Hammer, Heavenly Pollaxe, Eclipse Crossbow and the Lunar Staff. To craft these you need to combine a Moon Shard with a Hardened Moon Rod, which you can buy from the second floor of the shop for 10,250 candy.

However at the bottom of The Manor is another Altar that you can use to craft the Hallowing. To Craft you need to combine a piece of Raw Catseye, a Plastic Spider and a Broken Fence, during a Blood Moon.
